I have an iPhone 13 and want my Calendar and Notes apps in one folder. How do I do that?

Here is how to put Calendar and Notes into one folder on your iPhone.
1. Touch and hold the **Calendar** app until the apps jiggle.
2. Drag the **Calendar** app onto the **Notes** app.
3. Optional: to name the folder, touch and hold the folder until the quick actions menu appears.
4. Tap **Rename**.

I have an iPhone 15 and need to scan a signed form into a note in the Notes app. What do I tap?

Here is how to scan a form into a note on your iPhone.
1. Open **Notes** and select a note, or create a new one.
2. Tap the **Attachment button**, then tap **Scan Documents**.
3. Position the document in front of the camera.
If your device is in Auto mode, it scans automatically. Otherwise, tap the **Shutter button** or press a Volume button.
4. Drag the corners to fit the page.
5. Tap **Keep Scan**.
6. Tap the **Done button**, or add more scans to the document.
In iOS 26, you can also select options such as flash or an image filter. Alternatively, in an open note, tap the **More button**, then tap **Scan**.
